integrity: The proof is self-contained from the stated transitions. Exhaustive power-automaton checks for 4<=n<=18 and direct replay for 4<=n<=300 are supplied as corroboration, not as a substitute for the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The exact formula is proved only for the initial compression interval through h_n, plus a strict lower-bound failure at h_n+1; no formula is claimed beyond that boundary.
title: Exact initial compression profile of the \(D'_n\) automata
